[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]Gameplay:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Set up your store anywhere[/color], villagers will drop by and buy your items[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Turn your Farm buildings[/color] into a store or museum by obtaining a License[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Invite friends[/color] to visit your house the next day!!! Children may ask to play on your farm too![/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Gather your customers' reviews[/color] and be the best market in town.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Turn the island into a Paradise[/color], and there will be visitors every day.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#ffd966]Join the Paradise Island Festival[/color] Market Day!!![/size][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Setting up your first outdoor Store[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309?tab=videos#lg=2&slide=2]Video[/url]﻿[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Find yourself a good location.[/color] More people passing by means more chance of having a customer.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Place down a table.[/color] Remember to add some decoration around as well. Don't be a boring store.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Place any item[/color] on the table.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]And that's all you need[/color] to open up your own brand. Oh! Look like Lewis is taking a break and running to our store.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][spoiler]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]A location that has more NPC path will have a higher chance of customer ( Town > Bus Stop )[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Set up a Museum, a Restaurant, or a Market Store[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309?tab=videos#lg=2&slide=0]Video[/url]﻿[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Meet the requirement[/color] to obtain a License: Check out Market Town welcome letter or Market Log for detail[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Visit[/color] Desert Trader to get Market License, Saloon for Restaurant License, or Adventurer's Guide for Museum License[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Place a Sign inside the Farm Building,[/color] then display the License on that﻿.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][spoiler]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Buildings on Paradise Island have a chance for visitors, no requirement of License[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]When > 60% of items in a Building are in the same category ( e.g. Flower ), that Building will be determined as a themed shop ( e.g. Flower Shop )[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Invite your first Friend[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Craft an Invite Letter[/color], and give it to your friends[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]The higher the heart level, the higher the chance for a Yes[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Gather your customer reviews:[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#93c47d][size=3]Craft a Customer Note[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]After a villager purchased something, [/color]give them the note[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]They will let you know their opinion, and reward some friendship points too[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Open Paradise Island to visitors[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Craft a Paradise Island brazier, and light it on[/color] at the special spots[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]The number of visitors increases based on the Island Progress score[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][i][b]How to: Join Paradise Island Festival Market Day:[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]The Festival only occurs when the Island is open[/color] for visitors and on a weekly scheduled[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]During the festival,[/color] display your item for sale at the grange, and also check out others shops.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Sell during Festival day[/color] will be evaluated for Island Progress score[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]How to: Use AI content[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#93c47d][size=3]To config AI option, [/size][/color][size=3]see Config -> Advance, and you need to have Internet connected.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Have meaningful conversation with NPC. [/color]Try it by stand close by and chat. NPC have 'some memory' about your conversation[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Village comment[/color] about your items, decoration, ... will be VERY dynamic with AI[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Current limit:[/color] 8 AI interaction / ingame hour.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffd966][size=2][b]Disclaimer:[/b] If you enable AI, you agreed that some of your ingame stats will be sent to OpenAI to generate NPC dialogue (e.g. current season, [/size][/color]
[color=#ffd966][size=2]day of week, friendship,... ). Your personal computer data and your chat history is not being collected by me or OpenAI ( as their advertised ). 
However, it is a good practice to not share sensitive information.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]

[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]The mechanics behind:[/size]
[/color][size=2][u][i]If you want to dig into how does things work, here you are[/i][/u][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#00ff00]Furniture, items explain:[/color][/size][/font]
[spoiler][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]License:[/color] Is required to use a [b][u]Farm Building[/u][/b] as a business. After completing the requirement, a letter will show the next day letting you know the license is available. The license will show in the shop [b][u]ONLY[/u][/b] after the letter is opened. Buildings on Paradise Island do [b][u]NOT[/u] [/b]require a license.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Invite Letter:[/color] a letter you can give to villagers to invite them to visit your house the next day.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Customer Note: [/color]get the opinion about the latest item a villager purchased[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Market Town Storage Large/Small:[/color] Put items in there and it will have a chance to restock nearby tables [b][u]after[/u] [/b]an item is sold. If you set a new table, you have to put item on there first [u][b]manually[/b][/u].[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Restaurant Decor:[/color] Put this on a table and visitors will have a chance to 'sit' around the table and order food. Only valid in buildings with Restaurant or Market Town licenses, and Paradise Island houses.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Market Log:[/color] A log that shows many details about your sales, rating, ... Can buy at Robin shop.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#93c47d]Paradise Island brazier:[/color] Need to place it on a [b][u]special spot[/u][/b] on the island and light it up for visitors to arrive.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=4]Indoor store:[/size][/color][/font]
[spoiler][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=3]You can use any buildings on Farm as a store ( Shed, Cabin, Greenhouse, ... ). All you need is to display a License on a Sign inside:[/size]
[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Museum License: Donated 30 pieces to Museum; buy at Adventurer Guild. Visitor to buildings with Museum License will pay a ticket price based on the number of gems, minerals, artifacts, and statues inside. They do not buy the display items, but they might want to special order some foods.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Restaurant License: Sold 20 foods and earned > 10000G through [b][u]Market Town way only[/u][/b] ( not shipping bin ); buy at Gus. Visitors will buy and special order cooking items only.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Market Town License: Sold 30 of each Forage, Flower, Fruit, Vegetable, Artisan, Cooking, Fish, Animal Product, Gems & Mineral; and earn > 30000 through [b][u]Market Town way only[/u][/b] ( not shipping bin ); buy at Desert Trader. Visitors will buy and special request every giftable item, plus clothing displayed on the Mannequin.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#00ff00]Customer Rating:[/color][/size][/font]
[spoiler][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=3][size=3]Customer will rate: [color=#93c47d]The last item they bought today[/color] ( if the item is food, rate by the [b][u]gift taste[/u][/b], else rate by the [b][u]quality[/u][/b] ), 
[color=#93c47d]the decoration of the area[b] [u]near the item[/u][/b][/color]( 17x17 centered on the item), [color=#93c47d]the decoration of the area[b] [u]nearby themself[/u][/b][/color] ( 25x25 area; on Island and Farm only )[/size]
Customer rating is needed to level up Market Recognition level
[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Satisfaction Score: if item is food: hate -> love = 1 -> 5 stars; if not food: normal quality -> iridium quality = 2 -> 5 stars[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Aesthetic Rating: the number of tiles that are crops or decorations in the area, increased from 0 tile found to a maximum score at above 58 tiles ( for example a chair = 1 point, coffee table = 2 points, festival dining table = 10 points )[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=4]Paradise Island detail:[/size][/color][/font]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]A special island that has only 3 seasons Spring, Summer, and Fall. In spring every crop and fruit tree can grow ( like a greenhouse). Trees have a chance to grow faster, have extra daily fruits, and have higher maximum fruits.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]The island can be open for visitors. Then you can set up a resort and sell items ( which return higher price than any other place ). The visitors will randomly visit the Island house and any buildings on the Island.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]When the island is open for visitors, every Saturday will be a festival Market Day that you have yourself a grange to sell items, and some other villagers also have their own stalls. The money earned during this Market Day will be counted toward your Island Progress score.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Island Progress score is the money you earned during Market Day / 2000000 ( see Config ). A higher progress score mean more visitors to the island, unlock new shops during Market Day, higher sale prices, higher chance for crops to grow, ...[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]The Villagers' shop stock can be customized ( see Config -> Advance )[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=4]General:[/size][/color][/font]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][font=Comic Sans MS]The selling price differs by location: Paradise Island house > Paradise Island > Farm Building > others. Other factors affect price: gift taste (food), quality (non-food), decoration score, customer interaction score (per customer), during rush hour, market recognition level, store theme (licensed Farm Building only), island progress score (Paradise Island only)[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][font=Comic Sans MS]Customer interactions: After vanilla dialogue, there is a chance that NPC will be given some new dialogue. Interacting with them will increase your interaction count with that villager. If they buy anything later that day, they will pay a higher price than normal[/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][font=Comic Sans MS]A customer may have a chance to "recommend" your store to nearby villagers: If they are positive about the item (good quality, good taste, good decor), they will share a "positive recommendation", or "negative" otherwise. When nearby villagers receive "positive recommendation", it increases the chance they will buy something. If it is a "negative recommendation", they will not buy anything the rest of the day.[/font][/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
